featured_reviews.name: shweta jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointed with my experience at LookWell Salon, Chembur. I recently got a Hair Botox treatment and Gel Nail Paint service here. This is not my first visit to LookWell—I have previously availed services at the Badlapur branch and was always satisfied.

Unfortunately, the Chembur branch did not meet the same standards. The staff seemed more focused on attending another regular customer rather than providing proper attention to my service. I felt neglected throughout the appointment.

What disappointed me the most was the Hair Botox treatment. After my first wash using Kerastase shampoo and conditioner, my hair does not feel like it has undergone a Botox treatment at all. The texture, smoothness, and overall results are far below expectations, especially considering the amount charged for the service.

I chose LookWell based on my positive past experiences, but this visit has left me dissatisfied. I hope the management looks into both the service quality and customer attention at this branch.

featured_reviews.name: Sameer Jafar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited Look Well Salon today and had a really great experience. The salon had a clean and comfortable environment, which gave a very positive first impression.

Hair stylist Indresh Mistry did an amazing job. He carefully understood my requirements and delivered exactly the result I was expecting. His behavior was polite and professional, which made the experience even better.

The receptionist, Prajkta Store, was also very friendly and helpful. She guided me properly and managed everything smoothly, so the whole process felt easy and hassle free.

Overall, the service, staff behavior, and hygiene were all excellent. I would definitely visit again and highly recommend this salon to others.
